item.title: Deschamps predicts 'spectacular' France v Spain semi-final
item.description:
A Semi-Final Showdown for the Ages: France and Spain Gear Up for a Spectacular Clash

The stage is set for a monumental semi-final showdown in the World Cup 2026, as France and Spain prepare to face off in a highly anticipated match that promises to be nothing short of spectacular. France manager Didier Deschamps, a man with a proven track record of delivering on the biggest stages, has predicted a thrilling contest, one that will showcase the best of these two footballing powerhouses.
